title: Karl Nell's revised Kardashev scale
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Karl Nell's revised Kardashev scale, about 2023-2024 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Carl Nell, who set up Army Futures Command and was, you know, um, kind of defending Grush publicly as soon as he came out and and, uh, was on the UAP task force. He talks about a different version of the Cardesev scale.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels talks about Karl Nell, a man who helped set up Army Futures Command, an Army office that plans for future warfare, and who served on a government task force studying unidentified flying objects. Michels says Nell publicly backed David Grusch, a whistleblower who came forward with claims about UFOs, and that Nell describes his own version of the Kardashev scale, a way of ranking civilisations by how much energy they can use. If true, it suggests insiders are rethinking how to measure advanced non-human civilisations.
